finalText:
The real error was buried on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced a bare `retries` variable that didn't exist. The build was trying to pass `retries: 3` in the config object, but the code wasn't reading it from the environment parameter.

Fixed it to `env.retries || 1`, following the same pattern as the `cacheSize` field just above it. The build now runs clean with 3 warnings and 0 errors.
